Wellness and rewards programme
1. Aarogya StepUp: earn 1 StepUp coin for every 10 steps above 3,000 steps a day, synced through the Aarogya app (max 1,000 coins a day).
Coins can be redeemed in the in-app rewards store for fitness and health products. Coins expire 12 months after they are earned.
2. Renewal discount: 10% premium discount at renewal if the insured averages 8,000 steps a day over the policy year.
3. Discounts on partner services: up to 20% off at partner gyms, pharmacies and diagnostic centres listed in the app.
4. Health condition management: diet and weight management programme; stress management programme, both free via app.
How to claim
Cashless: available only at network hospitals. Check the network hospital list in the Aarogya app or on the website, or call 1800 000 1234. Intimate
us at least 48 hours before a planned admission and within 24 hours of an emergency admission. Show your e-card at the hospital insurance desk.
Reimbursement: submit the claim form, original bills, prescriptions and discharge summary within 30 days of discharge to
claims@aarogya-example.in or via the app. OPD, OPD dental and spectacles claims are reimbursement only.

Key exclusions: cosmetic or aesthetic treatment; spectacles beyond the stated limit; treatment outside India; maternity and newborn expenses;
self-inflicted injury; injuries from adventure sports; experimental treatments; non-medical items such as gloves, masks and toiletries above Rs.
2,000 per hospitalisation.
Co-payment: 20% co-payment applies on each claim if treatment is taken in a Zone A city (Mumbai, Delhi NCR) while the premium is paid for Zone
B.
Policy limits stated 'per policy' apply once across the full policy tenure unless stated as 'per policy year'.
